scope: Read-only live HTTP validation. No application code changed. 10 assets cover SSE/SZSE stocks and ETFs, BSE stock, HK stock/ETF, US stock/ETF, US class-share symbol.

protocol.tls: Default trusted CA verification enabled for every HTTPS request. No verify=False or insecure flags.
acceptance: HTTP 200 alone is not success: provider code, expected data key, nonempty samples, identity, chronological coverage, dates, and adjustment semantics checked.
Daily cycle routes fetch at least 5y of unadjusted daily bars, then filter calendar boundaries listed below. No aggregation/resampling needed.
Main/backup use different providers. Eastmoney alternate hosts are same-provider transport fallbacks only.
Historical source rows are preserved as small first/last excerpts with SHA-256 and response size; full downloaded responses were used in validation but are not committed.
No inference of current trade date from host clock alone: China/HK latest 2026-10-28, US latest completed session 2026-10-27.
US Tencent/ Yahoo minutes use New York exchange dates; Eastmoney US minute strings use Asia/Shanghai and cross midnight.
Reject empty response, empty klines, malformed JSON, unknown identity, partial coverage, and adjusted key when strict unadjusted requested; record errors.

findings.result: All 10 assets and four periods have usable safe routes. Tencent is strict-unadjusted primary except BJ; Eastmoney is conditional fallback with anomalous rows rejected. Coverage and provider bar quality are distinct; no blanket approval of every Eastmoney row.
Tencent usAAPL.OQ / usSPY.AM / usBRK.B.N; Eastmoney 105.AAPL / 107.SPY / 106.BRK_B; Yahoo AAPL / SPY / BRK-B. Wrong Eastmoney 106.SPY / 106.BRK.B / 106.BRK-B return no rows.

Tencent bj920185 daily returns only current day. Legacy nq835185 historical bars end 2025-09-30 and cannot replace the new-code series. Use Eastmoney 0.920185 fqt=0; independent Sina bj920185 returns current complete 1500-day history.

usfqkline blank adjustment token returns bad params. qfq640 returns qfqday; qfq1500 returns limit error. hfq640 returns key day, whose key alone does not prove raw data because the request asks adjustment. Do not use this specialized route for strict raw. Generic fqkline blank token is the validated raw route, including pre/post AAPL split evidence.

Generic Tencent blank-adjustment AAPL 2020-08-03 close=435.750 before 4-for-1 split, and 2020-09-15 close=115.540 after split. This confirms historical prices are not automatically split-normalized. See extra historical request in charts-usAAPL.OQ.json.

0700.HK Yahoo 2021-10-28 quote close=450.0503234863281 while Tencent and Eastmoney fqt=0 close=488.200. Merely choosing quote.close instead of adjclose does not guarantee strict unadjusted historical prices.

Tencent minute string is time, price, cumulative volume, optional cumulative turnover; Eastmoney klt=1 is minute OHLC and per-bar volume, not cumulative. Extract close when used as a line. Do not sum Tencent cumulative values. CN Tencent ETF/stock267 points extend beyond15:00; HK332 points can include closing auction to16:06. Yahoo raw minute ranges contain null/lunch rows. These must not be coerced to zero.

Tencent US minute 09:30-16:00 is America/New_York on 2026-10-27. Eastmoney US 2026-10-27 21:31 to 2026-10-28 04:00 is Asia/Shanghai; exchange-date normalization must happen before day filtering. Yahoo timestamps are epoch seconds with exchangeTimezoneName metadata.

Keep source numeric precision. Tencent daily commonly has three decimal places; ETF tick formatting can differ from storage decimals. Eastmoney decimal metadata is available. Volume units were not independently certified and are null in per-asset results; do not compare, sum, or convert cross-provider volumes without a separate unit contract.

This is a point-in-time public unauthenticated endpoint validation, not an availability promise. Eastmoney requires a browser User-Agent/Referer in this environment; bare urllib probes were remotely closed. Primary and backup responses can differ in minute opening marks and rounded highs.

Eastmoney 107.SPY 2026-02-02 low=69.005 disagrees with Tencent689.425 and Yahoo689.4199829, while open/close/high agree. Explicit fqt=0 establishes no-adjustment request semantics but does not certify bar correctness. Require bar validation or reconcile with third source. AAPL has two smaller historical open/high differences, documented per asset.
